{{armor art infobox |profession = Ranger |campaign = [[Prophecies]], [[Factions]] |specialgallery = ranger Simple Mask | pvp = Simple Mask ([[PvP reward]])}} '''Ranger Simple Mask''' is a mask art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign. This mask is available as [[basic armor]] for all masks with lower than max [[armor rating]].
